name: rights-provider
description: Runtime rights boundary for protected-content access checks
author: elastos

authority.reason: Answers typed protected-content rights questions without exposing contract SDKs, chain RPC, wallet RPC, key-backend SDKs, raw CEKs, or provider credentials to app capsules.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from rights-provider authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.
